title: •J’Quille
caption: •J’Quille (V)
game_text: May deploy to a shielded site, and, for remainder of that turn, suspends ‘Hoth Energy Shield Rules’ at his site. Once per game, when deployed to a site, opponent loses 1 Force for each Light Side character present.
lore: Whiphid *spy* in league with Lady Valarian. Yearns for battle. Enjoys hearing the screams of his victims. Plotting to kill Jabba.
